paragraphs.text: Donal was a Neurok human on the plane of Mirrodin , and Bruenna 's father.

He was employed by the vedalken Pontifex after he improved serum processing machines and showed promise. As he immersed himself in the Pool of Knowledge , he had the epiphany that the Vedalken were evil. After that, he led an insurrection at Medev . Afterwards, the Synod had him killed and led Bruenna to hold a grudge against both Pontifex and the Synod.
